reason: P06-05 adds synthetic firm-A image-only transitions using explicit immutable image IDs/source revisions, same-schema migration inventory gates, verified encrypted backup and DP/config ownership, a journal with expected-image concurrency guard, exact DB/key checks and unchanged other containers including start times. verify_update builds a known P07-05 baseline and current source into distinct image IDs, exercises foreign/stale/config/catalog/schema rejection, a genuine HTTP-unready candidate with safe automatic image rollback, successful upgrade, no-op, post-upgrade payment/profile write and explicit rollback without DB restore. SubscriptionAccessTests covers overdue read-only/reopening behavior that must survive both releases; SubscriptionLedgerTests covers financial history/grant preservation. Existing initializer/recovery helpers are reused unchanged. CI adds only this scoped gate; no application, migration, dependency, frontend, normal Compose/Dockerfile or main8080 runtime change. The shared recovery seed accepts an optional due date at INSERT for an always-overdue canary; its existing default is unchanged. Immutable ledger UPDATE remains forbidden; the existing recovery gate runs for the changed seed caller. Rollback direction is bound to the last successful upgrade, preventing a forward image change with stale backup under rollback mode; positive/reverse/no-history/already-rolled-back policy checks and the real preflight rejection cover it. A separate real PostgreSQL fault-injection fixture commits a new payment during a controlled readiness failure; A must remain stopped with review state and the payment intact, while B data, start time and HTTP readiness remain healthy. Final failure-path review adds an explicit stop if the previous-image recovery itself fails; a second real fixture commits a payment during that recovery and verifies A is stopped/review, the payment and B health are preserved.
